breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified and removed the user's incorrect instruction to "take the torsional shear stress to vanish". The generated specification instead instructs to calculate the torsional shear stress and then use it in the plane stress analysis (τxy equal to the torsional shear stress), which matches the physics of the problem and the structure of the ground truth prompt.
